row3-title.text: The issue changes with the job

main-measured.text:
Measured on Main-A at 390 × 900 (Chromium, fallback fonts, remote images blocked)

Doorplate 0–96, purpose sentence 96–140 (two lines), hero 140–480 (390 × 340), paper tab 436–552 cut 44 into the plate, caption 560–604 (two lines at 15px). Standing row 1 at 613, standing row 3 at 701. The 664 line is Safari with toolbars.

Board content 7,986 of 8,000 at 390 (Main-B 4,362). Living room chapter 3,301, inside the 3,375 held-plate budget (V2-9).

Ruling B on SQ-1570: purpose sentence may take two lines, hero 340, hero caption shortened to three segments, placeholder notice moved beside the frame.

main-placeholders.text: All photographs are placeholders, not job imagery; see Credits. Main-A, Main-B and the desktop page carry this notice here, beside the frames, so the captions inside them read as they will in production.

main-b-continues.text: Continues from Main-A: the same phone page, from 06 Study to the colophon.

desktop-placeholders.text: All photographs are placeholders, not job imagery; see Credits. Captions inside this frame read as they will in production.

desktop-measured.text:
Measured on Frame 1 at 1440 × 900 (Chromium, fallback fonts), page-relative to the doorplate top

Doorplate 0–96, hero 104–752 (1440 × 648), paper tab 708–812 cut 44 into the plate with the 64px headline on one line, caption 820–842. Standing rows at 855, inside the 880 gate (hard fail past 900).

desktop-below-03.text:
Below chapter 03 the desktop page matches the Main-A and Main-B boards one-to-one; not redrawn.

Hero: 1440 × 648 from a 16:10 source, full bleed under a 96px band, capped at min(72svh, 648), object-fit cover around the stored focal point. Headline under the photograph, never on it.

ruling-Q1.text: Q1 (v2 form) · a 340–352px hero above the first money fact at 390, standing row 1 at about 610, the forest Pay act on screen two. Recommend yes, with standing row 1 at or above 620 as a hard gate. Reversible: the v1 order, standing line above the cover, is the fallback.

ruling-C2.text: C2 (amended) · photography may bleed edge to edge at 390 and 1440. No image exceeds 72% of viewport height, except the single held plate per page, which may reach min(780px, 100svh − 72px). The letterhead and purpose sentence sit above the first image. A shared sheet or the key plan may be the cover when no photograph meets the floor. The 120px cap still governs designer and admin surfaces.

ruling-V2-1.text: V2-1 Full-bleed eligibility · only job-made images bleed: uploads, installed rooms, scans, boards, sheets, photographs of her own piece wherever taken. Catalogue and brand photographs stop at pair and piece plates. Recommend yes.

ruling-V2-2.text: V2-2 The paper tab · an opaque paper tab cut into the plate is page furniture, not a scrim; headline ink is measured on paper. Recommend yes, with the notch, hairline and below fallback.

ruling-V2-3.text: V2-3 Link row below the standing rows at 390 · amends CPUX-01.2 and F3; the purpose sentence stays under the doorplate. Recommend yes.

ruling-V2-4.text: V2-4 Captions at 15px · supersedes the 12px allowance for captions that carry dates or names. Recommend yes.

ruling-V2-5.text: V2-5 Automatic crop reading of photographs of her home · recommend yes only after the client privacy page ships; code crops and the designer drag until then.

ruling-V2-6.text: V2-6 Crop and serving lane now · media-worker crops through R2 and a client-portal R2 binding, versus CSS-only crops until the media reconciliation. Recommend build now.

ruling-V2-7.text: V2-7 Held plate · 390 × min(780, 100svh − 72), one per page, never dimmed, never in Invoices or Approvals. Recommend yes; one line added to the since-yesterday contract.

ruling-V2-8.text: V2-8 Measure before sizing Phase 1 · one aggregate over the item images by source and host, plus header dimensions from a dry run. Recommend yes.

ruling-V2-9.text: V2-9 Held-plate chapter budget · the 2.5-screen chapter budget stands, except the one chapter that carries the held plate, which may run 3.75 screens (3,375px at 390). The living room measures 3,301. Recommend yes.

empty-cover.text: No photograph meets the cover floor yet, so the issue opens on the key plan at full measure: the cover is a drawing until a photograph arrives. Measured at 390 × 900: purpose 96–140, drawn plate 140–480, tab 436–552 cut 44, caption 560–604, standing row 1 at 613, row 3 at 701. Every chapter stays, in words where there is nothing yet.
